key_insight: Elastic net machine learning combined diffusion MRI and clinical data to classify epilepsy lateralization, with AUCs of 0.76–0.88; this study concerns epilepsy, not cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: The approach may complement presurgical epilepsy evaluation, but its clinical utility remains unestablished.
method: Retrospective analysis of 334 adults undergoing presurgical epilepsy evaluation.
Combined fractional anisotropy and mean diffusivity from 36 bilateral white matter tracts with clinical and demographic variables.
Evaluated supervised classifiers, focusing on elastic net logistic regression for lateralization.
evidence_signal: Left-sided versus bilateral or generalized epilepsy showed the strongest discrimination (AUC 0.88; accuracy 0.90), while right-sided versus left-sided classification achieved AUC 0.76.
watch_item: Single-center retrospective findings require further validation and integration with other presurgical data before clinical use.
paper_title: Epilepsy Lateralization by Elastic Net Regularization of a Diffusion Tensor Imaging Biomarker using Machine Learning
